sources.label: Elgiganten Hotlist
sources.notes: Continuous resale-focused poller. Runs on its own loop, NOT the scan scheduler: one Algolia multi-query round-trip per poll (~0.7s), every ~90s with randomised jitter, against the plain Algolia CDN which is not behind Elgiganten's bot mitigation. Reuses the shared cached API key, so it adds no load on the protected key endpoint. Filters on productTaxonomy so hits carry real categories (unlike the outlet index). Emits a listing only on a genuine discount signal: a cheapestBItem (B-grade/Fyndvara) unit below the new price, or a campaign price below beforePrice. The watchGroups below are only the FIRST-RUN SEED — categories, brands, keywords and cadence are owned by the dashboard (Settings -> Hotlist) and stored in SQLite preferences thereafter.

sources.label: Komplett demo
sources.notes: Listing feed of the Komplett demo watcher (src/services/komplettDemoPoller.js), not a scan source. The watcher owns fetching, cadence, categories and Discord alerts (dashboard Settings -> Komplett demo); after every check, and once at startup, its tracked products are mirrored into the main listing under this source id (src/services/komplettDemoListing.js). Products the watcher marks as gone, or whose category is deselected, drop out of the listing.
